words.gloss: for the protection of the four varṇas

hindi: चातुर्वर्ण्य की रक्षा के लिए अत्यन्त अधर्मियों पर औपनिषदिक प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
english: For the protection of the four varṇas, one should employ the secret (aupaniṣadika) practice against the most unrighteous.
notes: aupaniṣadika (adj. 'of the Upaniṣad' in the sense of the secret/occult part of the work, the subject of Book 14) is rendered 'secret (aupaniṣadika) practice'; the noun is not stated in the line, 'practice' is supplied. adharmiṣṭha = superlative of adharmin. Subject of prayuñjīta (the king) is not stated.

words.gloss: with credible pretexts of country, dress, craft, speech, family
in the guise of hunchbacks, dwarfs, Kirātas, mutes, deaf, dull, blind
in the enjoyments of the enemy's person

hindi: कालकूट आदि विषों का समूह, विश्वसनीय देश, वेश, शिल्प, भाषा और कुल के बहानों से, कुबड़ों, बौनों, किरातों, गूँगों, बहरों, जड़ों और अन्धों के रूप में, म्लेच्छ जाति के अभिप्रेत स्त्रियों और पुरुषों द्वारा, शत्रु के शरीर के उपभोगों में प्रयुक्त किया जाना चाहिए।
english: The class of poisons beginning with Kālakūṭa is to be administered, in the enemy's bodily enjoyments, by approved women and men of foreign-tribe kind, under credible pretexts of country, dress, craft, speech and family, in the guise of hunchbacks, dwarfs, Kirātas, mutes, the deaf, the dull and the blind.
notes: Order of the instrumentals is loose in the Sanskrit; I attach śraddheya... apadeśaiḥ (pretexts) and ...chadmabhiḥ (guises) to the women and men. kāla-kūṭa = name of a poison. avadhātavyaḥ: 'administered' is the natural sense of ava-√dhā here; the alternative 'applied/placed' is close. andhac.chadmabhir = andha-chadmabhiḥ (sandhi of the e-text, with unmarked join).

words.gloss: in the king's playthings, vessels, deposits, articles of use

hindi: गुप्तचर राजा के क्रीड़ा-साधनों, पात्रों, निधियों और द्रव्यों के उपभोग में शस्त्रों का निधान करें, और सत्र से जीविका चलाने वाले, रात्रि में विचरने वाले तथा अग्नि से जीविका चलाने वाले अग्नि का निधान करें।
english: Secret agents should make a deposit of weapons in the king's playthings, vessels, deposits and articles of use; and those living by sattra, night-wanderers and those living by fire [should make] a deposit of fire.

text_flags.why: possible typo: doubled bh; the same word is upabhoga in unit 2

notes: sattra-ājīvin: sattra is rendered literally (a 'sattra' cover or institution); the exact sense is not given by the line, so the alternative 'those living by a ruse/cover' is possible; low confidence on this word. The e-text '-' in ca-agni.nidhānam marks an unsandhied join; the verb 'should make' is understood for the second clause (bracketed in English). krīḍā-bhāṇḍa could also be 'toys and vessels' as separate members.

words.gloss: powder of variegated frog, kauṇḍinyaka, kṛkaṇa, five kuṣṭha, hundred-footed
powder of ucci-diṅga, kambalī, śata-kanda (or kardama), idhma, kṛkalāsa
powder of house-golika, blind snake, kakra-thorn, stinking insect, gomārikā

hindi: चित्र मेंढक, कौण्डिन्यक, कृकण, पाँच कुष्ठ और शतपदी का चूर्ण; उच्चिदिङ्ग, कम्बली, शतकन्द (या कर्दम), इध्म और कृकलास का चूर्ण; गृह-गोलिक, अन्धा साँप, कक्र-कण्टक, सड़ा कीट और गोमारिका का चूर्ण, भल्लातक, अवल्गु और जर से मिला हुआ, तत्काल प्राण हर लेता है; अथवा इनका धुआँ।
english: Powder of variegated frog, kauṇḍinyaka, kṛkaṇa, five kuṣṭha and the hundred-footed; powder of ucci-diṅga, kambalī, śata-kanda (or kardama), idhma and kṛkalāsa; powder of house-golika, blind snake, kakra-thorn, stinking insect and gomārikā, combined with bhallātaka, avalgu and jara, takes life at once; or the smoke of these.

text_flags.why: possible typo: ṇ for ṅ; unit 9 prints uccidiṅga
editors' doubt mark; unit 9 has śata.kardama; reading uncertain
possible: jara may be a slip for ja (avalgu-ja = from avalgu); reading doubtful

notes: Obscure names (kauṇḍinyaka, kṛkaṇa, kuṣṭha, ucci-diṅga, kambalī, śata-kanda/kardama, idhma, kṛkalāsa, golika, kakra, gomārikā, avalgu, jara) are kept as names; citra-bheka 'variegated frog', śata-padī 'hundred-footed' (centipede?), andha-ahi 'blind snake', pūti-kīṭa 'stinking insect' are literal. 'kṛkalāsa' commonly a chameleon-like lizard; left as name. 'idhma' literally kindling; sense here uncertain. 'saṃyuktaṃ' appears as 'samyuktaṃ' in the e-text (m before y written unsandhied), same in later units. Alternative: eteṣāṃ vā dhūmaḥ is a separate sentence 'or the smoke of these'.

hindi: अथवा कोई एक कीट, काले साँप और प्रियङ्गु के साथ तपाया हुआ, यह संयोग सुखा देता है; यह तत्काल प्राण हर लेने वाला माना गया है।
english: Or any one insect, heated with black snake and priyaṅgu: this combination would cause [one] to dry up; it is held to take life at once.
notes: The object of śoṣayet is not stated ('[one]' supplied in brackets). priyaṅgu kept as a name (a plant name). Verse metre: two 16-syllable lines (anuṣṭubh).

words.gloss: joined with powder of bhallātaka flowers

hindi: धामार्गव और यातुधान का मूल, भल्लातक के फूलों के चूर्ण से युक्त, आधे मास वाला है।
english: Root of dhāmārgava and yātudhāna, joined with powder of bhallātaka flowers: [the one] of half a month (ārdhamāsika).
notes: The split of dhāma.argava.yātu.dhāna is the e-text's own; dhāmārgava and yātudhāna may each be a single plant name (yātu-dhāna literally 'demon'); kept as names, low certainty on how the members group. ārdhamāsikaḥ is literally 'of/lasting half a month'; what it qualifies (a preparation whose effect or period is half a month) is not stated, so it is rendered literally; alternative: its effect lasts half a month.

words.gloss: joined with powder of bhallātaka flowers

hindi: व्याघातक का मूल, भल्लातक के फूलों के चूर्ण से युक्त, कीट-योग एक मास वाला है।
english: Root of vyāghātaka joined with powder of bhallātaka flowers: the insect compound of one month (māsika).
notes: vyāghātaka is kept as a name (it may also be the name of a bird or tree). māsika is rendered literally ('of one month'); the sense (duration of effect) is not stated. Compare unit 6.

hindi: पुरुषों के लिए एक कला भर, गधों और घोड़ों के लिए दुगुना, हाथियों और ऊँटों के लिए चौगुना।
english: [A dose of] one kalā in measure for men, double for asses and horses, fourfold for elephants and camels.
notes: 'dose' is supplied (bracketed); kalā is a small unit of measure. The line is elliptical (no verb).

words.gloss: smoke of śata-kardama, ucci-diṅga, karavīra, kaṭu-tumbī, fish
with straw of madana and kodrava

hindi: शतकर्दम, उच्चिदिङ्ग, करवीर, कटुतुम्बी और मछली का धुआँ, मदन और कोदो की पराली से अथवा हस्तिकर्ण-पलाश की पराली से, हवा वाले स्थान में हवा के अनुकूल छोड़ा गया, जब तक चलता है तब तक मारता है।
english: Smoke of śata-kardama, ucci-diṅga, karavīra, kaṭu-tumbī and fish, with straw of madana and kodrava or with straw of hastikarṇa-palāśa, directed in a windy place downwind, kills for as long as it moves.
notes: Plant, insect and fish names are kept as names (karavīra is split kara-vīra in the e-text). 'dhūmo' is the subject; the smoke is made with the straws as fuel/medium (instrumental). pravāta-anuvāte: alternatively 'where the wind blows, along the wind'. yāvat carati tāvat mārayati: literally 'as long as it goes, so long it kills'.

words.gloss: powder of pūki-insect, fish, kaṭu-tumbī, śata-kardama, idhma, Indra's cowherd
powder of stinking insect, small ārālā, hema, vidārī
joined with powder of goat's horn and hoof

hindi: पूकि कीट, मछली, कटुतुम्बी, शतकर्दम, इध्म और इन्द्रगोप का चूर्ण, अथवा सड़े कीट, छोटे आराला, हेम और विदारी का चूर्ण, बकरे के सींग और खुर के चूर्ण से युक्त, अन्धा करने वाला धुआँ है।
english: Powder of pūki-insect, fish, kaṭu-tumbī, śata-kardama, idhma and indra-gopa, or powder of stinking insect, small ārālā, hema and vidārī, joined with powder of goat's horn and hoof, is a blinding smoke.

text_flags.why: possible: pūti-kīṭa 'stinking insect' occurs in the next member; pūki is otherwise unexplained

notes: indra-gopa literally 'Indra's cowherd' (a name of a red insect); kept literal. kṣudra-ārālā: kṣudra 'small' taken as the member of the name; the grouping kṣudra/ārālā/hema/vidārī is uncertain. 'andhī.karo' = andhī-karaḥ (cvi formation 'making blind'). Names kept as names.

words.gloss: stinking karañja leaf, haritāla, manaḥ-śilā, guñja, red, cotton
words.gram: dvandva, n. (compound continues in next token)

words.gloss: straw, other, āsphoṭa, glass, cow-dung juice, ground

hindi: सड़े करञ्ज के पत्ते, हरिताल, मनःशिला, गुञ्जा, लाल रंग वाला, कपास, पराली, अन्य, आस्फोट, काँच और गोबर का रस, पीसा हुआ, अन्धा करने वाला धुआँ है।
english: Ground together: stinking karañja leaf, haritāla, manaḥ-śilā, guñja, ārakta, cotton, straw, other, āsphoṭa, glass and cow-dung juice: a blinding smoke.
notes: The e-text join '.-' after kārpāsa links it to palāla in the next token (one compound across a space); the print has no break. Several members are uncertain: ārakta (red; may qualify guñja), anya ('other', possibly part of a name or a slip), rasa (juice, not 'poison' here), kārpāsa-palāla ('cotton straw'). Low confidence; ingredient names kept literal. 'Ground together' is supplied from piṣṭam.

hindi: साँप की केंचुली, गाय और घोड़े का मल, और अन्धे साँप का सिर, अन्धा करने वाला धुआँ है।
english: Snake's slough, dung of cow and horse, and the head of a blind snake: a blinding smoke.
notes: The token 'ca-andhī.karo' carries ca and andhī-karaḥ. andha-ahika: 'blind snake' as in unit 4 (andha-ahi); the exact creature is not given.

words.gloss: kāsīsa, hiṅgu, barley, husk, kaṇa, rice grains
nimba, śigru, phaṇirja, kākṣīva, pīluka, bhaṅga
skin of snake and śapharī fish
powder of elephant's nail and horn
with straw of madana and kodrava

hindi: कबूतरों, प्लवकों और मांसभक्षियों का, तथा हाथी, मनुष्य और सूअर का मूत्र और मल; कासीस, हींग, जौ, भूसी, कण और चावल के दाने; कपास, कुटज और कोशातकी के बीज; गोमूत्रिका और भाण्डी की जड़; नीम, सहिजन, फणिर्ज, काक्षीव, पीलु और भङ्ग; साँप और शफरी मछली की खाल; हाथी के नख और सींग का चूर्ण; इस प्रकार यह धुआँ, मदन और कोदो की पराली से अथवा हस्तिकर्ण-पलाश की पराली से, प्रत्येक से अलग-अलग छोड़ा गया, जब तक चलता है तब तक मारता है।
english: Urine and dung of pigeons, plavakas and flesh-eaters, and of elephants, men and boars; kāsīsa, hiṅgu, barley, husk, kaṇa and rice grains; seeds of cotton, kuṭaja and kośātakī; root of gomūtrikā and bhāṇḍī; nimba, śigru, phaṇirja, kākṣīva, pīluka and bhaṅga; skin of snake and śapharī fish; powder of elephant's nail and horn: thus this smoke, applied with straw of madana and kodrava or with straw of hastikarṇa-palāśa, each separately, kills for as long as it moves.
notes: A catalogue of ingredients; names kept as names, not identified (kośātakī is split kośa-atakī in the e-text; plavaka 'a water-bird?' left as name; kaṇa not translated; bhaṅga could be 'hemp' or 'breaking'; the whole list is the content of the smoke). 'ity eṣa dhūmaḥ' closes the list: 'thus this smoke'. pratyekaśaḥ: each of the groups separately (alternative: each ingredient).

words.gloss: root of kālī, kuṣṭha, naḍa, śatāvalī
powder of snake, pracalāka, kṛkaṇa, five kuṣṭha
in the crowds of battle, descent, assault
by those who have made the remedy for the eyes of water-washing

hindi: काली, कुष्ठ, नड और शतावली की जड़, अथवा साँप, प्रचलाक, कृकण और पाँच कुष्ठ का चूर्ण; यह धुआँ, पहले बताई विधि से गीली या सूखी पराली के साथ छोड़ा गया, युद्ध, उतरने और आक्रमण की भीड़ में, आँखों के जल से धोने का उपचार कर चुके लोगों द्वारा छोड़ा गया, सब प्राणियों की आँखों का नाश करने वाला है।
english: Root of kālī, kuṣṭha, naḍa and śatāvalī, or powder of snake, pracalāka, kṛkaṇa and five kuṣṭha: the smoke, applied by the former procedure with wet or dry straw, applied in the crowds of battle, descent and assault by those who have made the remedy for the eyes of washing with water, is the destroyer of the eyes of all living beings.
notes: pūrva-kalpena refers back to the earlier preparation (units 9, 13). The long compound kṛta-nejana-udaka-akṣi-pratīkāraiḥ is taken as 'by those for whom the remedy of the eyes by washing with water has been made'; low-medium certainty; alternative: 'with remedies for the eyes (i.e. washing with water) made'. The e-text '-' in pūrva.kalpena-ārdra marks an unsandhied join. 'sarpa' may be a snake or part of a name; kept as 'snake'.

words.gloss: dung of śārikā, pigeon, heron, crane
ground with arka, akṣi-pīluka, snuhi milk

hindi: शारिका, कबूतर, बगुला और बलाका की बीट, आक, अक्षिपीलु और थूहर के दूध के साथ पीसी हुई, अन्धा करने वाला अञ्जन है और जल को दूषित करने वाली भी।
english: Dung of śārikā, pigeon, heron and crane, ground with arka, akṣi-pīluka and snuhi milk, is a blinding ointment (añjana) and also a polluter of water.
notes: leṇḍa = dung (of birds). Plant names (arka, akṣi-pīluka, snuhi) kept; 'milk' of snuhi is kṣīra (sap/milk). akṣi-pīluka may be two names (akṣi, pīluka). 'añjana' = salve for the eyes.

words.gloss: compound of yavaka, śāli root, madana fruit, jātī leaf, human urine
joined with plakṣa and vidārī root
joined with decoction of mūka, udumbara, madana, kodrava

hindi: यवक, शालि की जड़, मदन का फल, जाती के पत्ते और मनुष्य के मूत्र का योग, प्लक्ष और विदारी की जड़ से युक्त, अथवा मूक, उदुम्बर, मदन और कोदो के काढ़े से युक्त, अथवा हस्तिकर्ण-पलाश के काढ़े से युक्त, मदन-योग है।
english: A compound of yavaka, root of śāli, fruit of madana, leaf of jātī and human urine, joined with plakṣa and root of vidārī, or joined with a decoction of mūka, udumbara, madana and kodrava, or joined with a decoction of hastikarṇa-palāśa: it is a madana compound.
notes: madana (a plant name; also 'intoxication') kept as a name in madana-yoga; the effect is not stated here. mūka (literally 'mute') is taken as a drug name, uncertain. kvātha = decoction.

words.gloss: compound of śṛṅgi, gautama, vṛka, kaṇṭaka, ara, peacock-foot
compound of guñjā, lāṅgalī, poison-root, iṅgudī
compound of karavīra, akṣi-pīluka, arka, deer-killer
joined with decoction of madana and kodrava

hindi: शृङ्गी, गौतम, वृक, कण्टक, अर और मयूरपदी का योग; गुञ्जा, लाङ्गली, विषमूलिका और इङ्गुदी का योग; करवीर, अक्षिपीलु, आक और मृगमारणी का योग, मदन और कोदो के काढ़े से युक्त, अथवा हस्तिकर्ण-पलाश के काढ़े से युक्त, मदन-योग है।
english: A compound of śṛṅgi, gautama, vṛka, kaṇṭaka, ara and mayūra-padī; a compound of guñjā, lāṅgalī, viṣa-mūlika and iṅgudī; a compound of karavīra, akṣi-pīluka, arka and mṛga-māraṇī, joined with a decoction of madana and kodrava, or joined with a decoction of hastikarṇa-palāśa: it is a madana compound.

text_flags.why: possible typo: madna for madana (cf. unit 16 and the end of this unit)

notes: Names kept as names (mayūra-padī literally 'peacock-foot'; mṛga-māraṇī literally 'deer-killer'; viṣa-mūlika 'poison-root'). Whether the decoction clause belongs to the last compound only or to all three is not clear; rendered as in the Sanskrit order (to the last), alternative: to all.

words.gloss: polluters of fodder, fuel and water

hindi: अथवा सब मिलाकर घास, ईंधन और जल को दूषित करने वाले हैं।
english: Or, all together, they are polluters of fodder, fuel and water.
notes: 'they' refers back to the preceding compounds (units 16 and 17); samastā(ḥ) vā is 'or all together'.

words.gloss: smoke of kṛta, kaṇḍala, kṛkalāsa, house-golika, blind snake

hindi: कृत, कण्डल, कृकलास, गृह-गोलिक और अन्धे साँप का धुआँ आँखों का नाश और उन्माद करता है।
english: The smoke of kṛta, kaṇḍala, kṛkalāsa, house-golika and blind snake causes destruction of the eyes and madness.
notes: 'kṛta.kaṇḍala' is obscure: taken as two names, or kṛta-kaṇḍala 'made [into] kaṇḍala'; low confidence. Other names as in unit 4.

hindi: कृकलास और गृह-गोलिका का योग कुष्ठ करने वाला है।
english: A compound of kṛkalāsa and house-golikā produces kuṣṭha.
notes: kuṣṭha (the skin disease; also the name of a plant) is kept as kuṣṭha, here the disease is the natural sense.

words.gloss: joined with one intestine and honey

hindi: वही चित्र, एक अन्त्र और मधु से युक्त होकर प्रमेह उत्पन्न करता है, मनुष्य के रक्त से युक्त होकर शोष।
english: That same one, joined with citra, one intestine and honey, brings about prameha; joined with human blood, wasting (śoṣa).

text_flags.why: possible: the word may be a drug name; reading doubtful

notes: 'sa eva' refers to the preceding compound (unit 20). 'citram' is obscure (a drug name citra, or adverb 'variously'); 'eka-antra' literally 'one intestine', possibly part of a name; low confidence. prameha and śoṣa are kept as the named conditions (śoṣa literally 'drying up, wasting'). 'brings about' is supplied for śoṣam from āpādayati.

hindi: दूषी विष, मदन और कोदो का चूर्ण, अपजिह्विका-योग है।
english: Dūṣī poison, powder of madana and kodrava: the apajihvikā compound.
notes: dūṣī-viṣa (a technical term, 'slow-acting/vitiated poison' in later usage) kept as 'dūṣī poison'; apajihvikā (literally 'uvula, lit. off-tongue') kept as a name. The line is elliptical; how the three items relate is not stated. Rendered literally as a list.

words.gloss: compound of mātṛ-vāhaka, añjali-kāra, pracalāka, frog, akṣi-pīluka

hindi: मातृवाहक, अञ्जलिकार, प्रचलाक, मेंढक और अक्षिपीलु का योग विषूचिका करने वाला है।
english: A compound of mātṛ-vāhaka, añjali-kāra, pracalāka, frog and akṣi-pīluka produces viṣūcikā.
notes: Names kept (añjali-kāra literally 'añjali-maker'; mātṛ-vāhaka literally 'mother-carrier'). viṣūcikā is kept as the named condition.

words.gloss: compound of five kuṣṭhaka, kauṇḍinya, flowers of the karāja tree, honey

hindi: पाँच कुष्ठक, कौण्डिन्य, करांज वृक्ष के फूल और मधु का योग ज्वर करने वाला है।
english: A compound of five kuṣṭhaka, kauṇḍinya, flowers of the karāja tree and honey produces fever.
notes: karāja is kept as a tree name (may be karañja). jvara = fever.
